question: Does frozen current-main behaviour contain enough exact, reproducible and Scoreline-separated same-enemy re-Shatter capacity to justify implementing one binary Duskblade research mediator?
competingOptions: authorise only the exact reseam-break mediator below for identity preflight
close this mediator without implementation and continue to another evidence-backed structural mechanism inside issue #421
record an inconclusive result at the frozen cap

candidate.producer: The first real Duskblade Shatter of a specific living enemy in the current combat.
candidate.consumer: The second real Shatter of that same enemy in that combat, after its first reseam has increased facet_max by one.
candidate.payoff: At level 1, gain exactly 1 immediately usable Energy on that enemy's second Shatter only; at level 0, do nothing. Further Shatters of that enemy add no reward.
candidate.scope: Duskblade only, once per enemy per combat. Adamant Hold is not a Shatter and cannot count. The factor changes no facet threshold, chip, damage, Ward, draw, healing, status, card, offer, acquisition, rarity, policy score or RNG call.
candidate.mechanisticJustification: Current main anneals an enemy after its first true Shatter by increasing facet_max. A second Shatter of the same enemy therefore identifies policies that deliberately overcome a harder reseamed pane, a narrower state/action sequence than the already closed broad Shatter-threshold and heavy-Attack families.
candidate.structuralSeparation: The state machine contains neither Chisel nor Faultline, does not read Scoreline, Ward, Afterimage or Kindle, and cannot fire for Ashwarden.
candidate.productBoundary: The research factor has no product ownership or acquisition path. If causal evidence later selects it, the smallest deterministic product carrier and its real reachability require a separate frozen admission test.
candidate.claimBoundary: A capacity pass authorises only implementation and omitted/null path, RNG and result identity plus focused mediator isolation. It is not causal activation, complementarity, outcome benefit, content admission or product scope.

witnessDefinitions.exactActiveRow: At least one fight has exactly one enemy identity and at least two recorded Shatters. Every Shatter in such a fight necessarily belongs to that enemy.
witnessDefinitions.possibleActiveRow: At least one fight has at least two recorded Shatters, regardless of enemy count.
witnessDefinitions.robustExactActivePolicy: At least two of four frozen rows are exact-active rows.
witnessDefinitions.exactInactivePolicy: None of the four frozen rows is even a possible-active row. This is sufficient to prove that no same-enemy re-Shatter occurred.
witnessDefinitions.ambiguousPolicy: Every remaining policy, including multi-enemy fights whose aggregate Shatter count cannot identify the target and one-of-four exact witnesses.
witnessDefinitions.successfulFightWitness: An exact witness in a fight whose recorded result is win. This is only a local capacity check; whole-run viability remains a later causal gate.
witnessDefinitions.selectionTiming: Definitions, two-of-four robustness and every gate are frozen before witness counts are read. Ambiguous policies may not be reclassified after the result.

closedDirections: the Shatter-to-heavy-Attack Energy relay and any subset of its six eligible cards
Shatterer's Crown offer, threshold and Fervor families
the immutable issue #524 and issue #525 exhausted paths

baseline.name: current-main root-551 Duskblade Vow-5 natural reward/economy rectangle

cohort.scorelineCapacityProxy: At least two frozen rows play both Chisel and Faultline. This is only a necessary non-alias proxy; exact Scoreline causal admission remains owned by prior held-out evidence.

gates.provenance: The 16 active/16 inactive and eight successful/separation minima reuse the frozen 64-policy first-look support scale. Two acts reject a one-encounter artefact, and the unchanged Jaccard ceiling rejects a near-alias of Scoreline.

decisionRules.success: Every frozen source, exact active, exact inactive, successful-fight, act-breadth and Scoreline-separation gate passes.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Implement only the exact binary reseamBreakEnergy research factor and prove omitted/null path, RNG and result identity plus factor isolation before any causal row. Then preregister a mediator-first CRN experiment with fixed policies, seeds, baseline, estimator, caps and stop rules.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Close reseam-break without implementation or simulator spend and continue with the next evidence-backed structural mechanism inside issue #421. Do not change the threshold, include multi-enemy ambiguous rows or retune the payoff.
decisionRules.inconclusive: The deterministic screen reaches the frozen wall-time cap before a decision.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Record the inconclusive result at the cap without implementation or simulator spend.
